modelOverview: The Code 11:59 Tourbillon Openworked pairs the collection's architectural 41mm case, blending a round bezel with an octagonal middle case, with Audemars Piguet's hand-wound flying tourbillon Calibre 2948. The fully skeletonised movement, with blackened bridges set against a rhodium-toned mainplate, is left completely exposed and hand-finished with dozens of polished angles. It represents one of the collection's most technically ambitious executions, reserved for precious-metal cases.

26600OR.OO.D002CR.01.movement: Hand-wound · Audemars Piguet Calibre 2948 flying tourbillon · ~80h power reserve · 21,600vph (3Hz)
26600OR.OO.D002CR.01.dial: Fully openworked/skeletonised dial with lacquered black inner minutes track and 18ct pink gold hands
26600OR.OO.D002CR.01.description: A Code 11:59 flying tourbillon in AP's signature 41mm pink gold case, its dial entirely openworked to reveal the hand-wound Calibre 2948 with blackened, hand-bevelled bridges floating over a rhodium-toned mainplate. The 4.97mm-thick movement carries 70 hand-polished V-angles across its 196 components, paired with a black alligator strap and pink gold folding clasp. Every piece is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.
